chain.title: Iron Laced With Quartz
chain.desc: Craft quartz enriched iron from iron ingots and nether quartz; it is the base metal of every Refined Storage component.

chain.title: Sand Of Pure Thought
chain.desc: Smelt nether quartz into silicon, the wafer every processor is printed on.

chain.title: Slime And Sinew
chain.desc: Bind slimeballs with string to make the processor binding that holds a raw circuit together.

chain.title: The First Circuit Fires
chain.desc: Combine silicon, iron, redstone and a processor binding into a raw basic processor, then smelt it into the finished chip.

chain.title: A Shell Worth Building In
chain.desc: Ring stone with quartz enriched iron to form the machine casing that houses nearly every network block.

chain.title: Gilded Logic
chain.desc: Swap the iron for gold to print an improved processor, the mid-tier chip used by grids and upgrades.

chain.title: The Mind That Places
chain.desc: Mix a basic processor with glowstone dust to make the construction core, the half of the network that puts things down.

chain.title: The Mind That Breaks
chain.desc: Mix a basic processor with nether quartz to make the destruction core, the half of the network that takes things apart.

chain.title: Diamond-Cut Reasoning
chain.desc: Print a raw advanced processor with a diamond and smelt it; controllers, disk drives and crafters all demand one.

chain.title: The Network Draws Breath
chain.desc: Build the controller from advanced processors, silicon and a machine casing. Everything downstream needs its power.

chain.title: Threading The Network
chain.desc: Craft cable from quartz enriched iron, redstone and glass to carry the network signal between blocks.

chain.title: A Window Into Everything
chain.desc: The grid pairs a construction and destruction core with an improved processor, giving you a searchable view of the whole network.

chain.title: An Empty Vessel
chain.desc: Craft the storage housing that any storage part can be slotted into to become a finished disk.

chain.title: One Thousand Promises
chain.desc: Silicon, glass, redstone and quartz enriched iron form the 1k storage part, the first rung of the disk ladder.

chain.title: First Platter Spun Up
chain.desc: Seat a 1k storage part into a storage housing to make a working 1k disk holding one thousand items.

chain.title: The Spinning Library
chain.desc: Craft the disk drive from a chest, machine casing and advanced processors; it is where the network's disks actually live.

chain.title: Pulling Things Inward
chain.desc: Cable, a destruction core and an improved processor make the importer, which sucks items out of adjacent inventories.

chain.title: Pushing Things Outward
chain.desc: The mirror of the importer, built with a construction core, feeding items back out to machines and chests.

chain.title: Annexing The Chests
chain.desc: External storage exposes an entire adjacent inventory to the network without moving a single item into a disk.

chain.title: Craft Without Carrying
chain.desc: Upgrade a grid into a crafting grid so recipes pull their ingredients straight from network storage.

chain.title: Blueprints On Glass
chain.desc: The pattern grid writes recipes onto patterns, the instruction sheets autocrafting runs on.

chain.title: Hands That Never Tire
chain.desc: Load patterns into a crafter and the network builds recipes on demand instead of waiting on you.

chain.title: Casting The Signal Out
chain.desc: An ender pearl, advanced processor and machine casing broadcast the network beyond its cables.

chain.title: Your Storage, Untethered
chain.desc: Bind a wireless grid to a transmitter and carry the entire network in one inventory slot.

notes: Chain derived from data/refinedstorage/recipes/**. Verified dependency spine: iron+quartz -> quartz_enriched_iron; quartz -(smelt)-> silicon; slimeball+string -> processor_binding; silicon+binding+iron/gold/diamond -> raw_{basic,improved,advanced}_processor -(smelt)-> processor; stone+quartz_enriched_iron -> machine_casing; basic_processor+glowstone/quartz -> construction_core/destruction_core; controller needs advanced_processor+machine_casing+silicon. Storage ladder confirmed as 1k -> 4k (basic_processor) -> 16k (improved_processor) -> 64k (advanced_processor); fluid ladder 64k -> 256k -> 1024k -> 4096k. Disks are part+storage_housing. Autocrafting spine confirmed: pattern (glass+redstone+qei) -> pattern_grid -> crafter (advanced_processor + both cores) -> crafter_manager/crafting_monitor. Wireless line confirmed: wireless_grid = grid + advanced_processor + ender pearl, and wireless_transmitter is the paired network block. MODDB AGREEMENT: quartz_enriched_iron first (pos 0.0), machine_casing 0.073, basic_processor 0.083, controller 0.12, disk_drive 0.397, crafting_grid 0.528 -- all match the recipe order used here. MODDB CONFLICTS: (1) moddb ranks silicon at 0.207, i.e. AFTER machine_casing and basic_processor, but the recipe graph requires silicon before any processor exists -- recipe order used. (2) moddb ranks importer 0.159 / exporter 0.247 before grid 0.456 and disk_drive 0.397; published packs gate these cheap I/O blocks early, but they are useless before a controller and drive exist, so they are placed after the drive here. (3) moddb ranks external_storage and portable_grid at 0.306, before grid -- both literally require a grid/controller in their recipe, so recipe order was used. COLOR VARIANTS: the jar ships 16 dyed recipes for controller/grid/crafter/etc., but only the base ids carry lang keys, so no dyed id is used anywhere in this file. silk_touch_upgrade and fortune_*_upgrade use the custom recipe type refinedstorage:upgrade_with_enchanted_book (enchanted book + upgrade), not a vanilla shaped recipe. ID VERIFICATION: every id in this file was set-membership-checked against the jar; nothing was dropped.
